name: Nagrik Saathi
description: Guidance for Indian public government notices: summary, deadlines, scam signals, action checklists, and links to a human-reviewed portal registry. Guidance only, not an official government decision. The agent never pays, submits forms, or contacts officials.

skills.name: Explain a notice
skills.description: Summarize a public notice in one of eight Indian languages, including issuer, amount due, deadline, reference number, and required documents.
examples: Explain this electricity bill notice in Marathi.

skills.name: Verify an official portal
skills.description: Check a URL against a human-reviewed registry of official government portals. Returns the registry URL, never the supplied URL as an official destination.

skills.name: Redact personal identifiers
skills.description: Redact Aadhaar-like, PAN, payment-card, and long account-like numbers locally. Pattern-based, not a guarantee.
examples: Remove personal numbers from this notice before I share it.

skills.name: Create an action plan
skills.description: Produce a safe checklist and required-document list. The agent does not make payments, submit forms, or contact officials.
examples: What should I do next for this notice?

x-nagrik-saathi.note: No A2A endpoint is deployed. This file records intended identity only and must not be treated as a live agent. The implemented surface is the MCP server in mcp/, which exposes ten read-only tools over stdio or Streamable HTTP.
